---
title: Données météorologiques
metadata-files: 
  - _common_fr.yml
---



```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "Europe/Paris"))
source(here::here("code", "meteo.R"))

## cd ~/iCloud/website/data; /usr/local/bin/R -e 'quarto::quarto_render("index.qmd")'
## cd ~/iCloud/website/data; /usr/local/bin/R -e 'quarto::quarto_render("pouvoir-achat.qmd")'
## sh ~/iCloud/website/website_short.sh

stations <- c("07156" = "Paris", "07157" = "Roissy", "07015" = "Lille", "07650" = "Marseille", "07490" = "Chamonix")
daily <- meteo_daily(stations, 30)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      dpi = 150, fig.align = "center", out.width = "560px")
```

# Comparaison par jour

## Températures maximales, 30 derniers jours

```{r, fig.width = 4.2, fig.height = 9}
meteo_plot_heatmap(daily, "tmax")
```

## Température moyenne

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4}
meteo_plot_lines(daily, "tmoy")
```


# Paris-Montsouris (07156)

## 48 dernières heures

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 6.5}
meteo_plot_hours("07156", "Paris-Montsouris — 48 dernières heures")
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Tableau heure par heure

```{r}
meteo_station_heure_par_heure("07156", from = Sys.Date() - 2)
```
:::

## 30 derniers jours

```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 6}
meteo_plot_days(dplyr::filter(daily, station == "Paris"), "Paris-Montsouris — 30 derniers jours")
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Tableau jour par jour

```{r}
meteo_station_last_days("07156", 30)
```
:::
